So native histograms without custom buckets (standard exponential schema) are only emitted for protobuf formats (delim, text, compact). TextPlain is not permitted → dropped.

Custom-bucket histograms (NHCB, schema -53) bypass the skip because UsesCustomBuckets() is true, so they are converted to classic histograms via makeClassicHistogram and can be served in all negotiated formats including text/plain (the exposition layer adds the +Inf bucket — comment lines 373-376).

Ordinary float samples: restriction applies only when isHistogram (s.H != nil), so float samples are unaffected; they're always emitted as untyped, regardless of format. Lines 290-294.

Also note the docs/federation.md lines 9-16 claims. Let's read docs/federation.md lines 1-25 for the claim about mixing.
